title: Popover
description: A click-triggered floating panel for interactive content such as filters or account menus, anchored to its trigger. Unlike Tooltip it holds focusable content and manages focus, Escape and outside clicks itself; inside a Modal it closes first.

support.notes: Controlled/default compound state; separate trigger/anchor native measurement; side/align/offset, viewport flip/shift/size, matchAnchorWidth, arrow, forceMount; cancelable dismiss/focus callbacks; resize/native polling cleanup. H5 supports body Teleport, composed asChild triggers/anchors/close actions, modal focus trap, inert background and scroll locking. Native panels use fixed host geometry; native views cannot reproduce browser child cloning or document focus semantics. Component tests, H5 tests in happy-dom and the official uni-app WeChat SDK compilation fixture pass. Physical-device E2E and other native targets are not verified.

translationResources.title: Popover
translationResources.description: A click-triggered floating panel for interactive content such as filters or account menus, anchored to its trigger. Unlike Tooltip it holds focusable content and manages focus, Escape and outside clicks itself; inside a Modal it closes first.

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: PopoverTrigger toggles the panel; focus moves inside and returns to the trigger on close. PopoverClose closes it. In a non-modal popover, Tab past the last element (Shift+Tab before the first) closes it and moves focus to the element after (before) the trigger; focus never loops inside.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: side, align and sideOffset position the panel; it flips and shifts to stay in view. arrow points at the trigger.

controlled.title: Controlled with an anchor
controlled.description: open + onOpenChange control the state; PopoverAnchor positions the panel against another element.

PopoverProps.open: Controlled open state; leave undefined for uncontrolled
PopoverProps.onOpenChange: Called with the requested open state (trigger, Escape, outside click, PopoverClose)
PopoverProps.modal: Modal mode: traps focus (Tab loops inside the panel), locks page scrolling, hides the rest of the page from assistive technology and blocks outside pointer interaction (an outside click still closes it)

PopoverContentProps.side: Preferred side; flips when there is not enough room
PopoverContentProps.sideOffset: Gap to the trigger in pixels
PopoverContentProps.arrow: Renders an arrow pointing at the trigger
PopoverContentProps.portal: Renders the panel into a portal (the theme-scoped container of a nested ConfigProvider, else document.body)
PopoverContentProps.alignOffset: Skid along the trigger in pixels (positive = towards the end)
PopoverContentProps.collisionPadding: Minimum distance to the viewport edges in pixels; currently fixed at 8px, other values are reserved
PopoverContentProps.matchAnchorWidth: Sizes the panel after the trigger / anchor width: "min" at least as wide, "exact" exactly as wide
PopoverContentProps.forceMount: Keeps the panel mounted while closed (data-state="closed"), e.g. for animation libraries
PopoverContentProps.onOpenAutoFocus: Called before focus moves into the panel on open; event.preventDefault() keeps focus where it is
PopoverContentProps.onCloseAutoFocus: Called before focus returns to the opener on close; event.preventDefault() skips it
PopoverContentProps.onEscapeKeyDown: Escape pressed while it is the topmost layer; event.preventDefault() keeps it open
PopoverContentProps.onPointerDownOutside: Pointer pressed outside; event.preventDefault() keeps it open
PopoverContentProps.onFocusOutside: Focus moved outside; event.preventDefault() keeps it open
PopoverContentProps.onInteractOutside: Pointer down or focus outside; event.preventDefault() keeps it open

PopoverTriggerProps.asChild: Merges the behaviour onto the single child element instead of rendering its own element

cssVars.--popover-background: Background of the panel and its arrow
cssVars.--popover-border-color: Border color of the panel and its arrow
cssVars.--popover-shadow: Shadow of the panel (defaults to --shadow-lg, --shadow-xl in dark themes)
cssVars.--popover-z-index: Stacking order of the panel (defaults to --z-popover)

basic.title: Basic usage
basic.description: The trigger slot toggles an interactive panel; focus moves in and returns on close. Escape, an outside click or an element with data-popover-close closes it.

placement.title: Placement
placement.description: side and align place the panel around the trigger, side-offset sets the gap and arrow points at it; it flips and shifts to stay in the viewport.

anchor.title: Anchor and modal
anchor.description: anchor positions the panel against another element (by id) while any button opens it with show(); modal traps focus and blocks the rest of the page.

props.label: Accessible name of the panel (or set aria-label on the element).
props.anchor: Id of the element (same tree) to anchor to.
props.anchorElement: Element the panel is positioned against instead of the trigger; takes precedence over anchor.

events.minerva-open-change: The user asked to open / close (detail: { open, reason }); cancelable: preventDefault() keeps the current state.
events.minerva-after-close: Fired once the panel has finished closing (after its exit animation).

slots.trigger: Element that toggles the popover when clicked.
